description.content: Returns all vocabularies (standard and custom) keyed on object name with values keyed on field name. If no object names are provided, vocabularies for all objects are returned.

query.description: Names of objects to fetch vocabularies for in comma separated format. If not provided all vocabularies are returned.
If set to true the cache is replaced with a new value. Has no effect if 'names' are provided as individual objects are not cached.

response.name: Successful operation
